name: Centered all-seen head-loss objective, three seeds with qualified reused controls
purpose: Test whether removing per-task common-mode logits inside the head loss avoids the old-task damage of raw all-seen CE, while improving over the current-CE model with the same fixed centered inference. This is a new falsifiable hypothesis, not a retrospective repair of the failed raw all-seen experiment.
previous_result: All six previous branches qualified, raw new+5.30pp but old-3.5833pp and old T1 losses6/7.1/12.4pp; primary gate FAILED. Both centered: overall-.4667pp, old-.8667pp, new+.3333pp. Restricted current-class accuracy also declined.
scientific_change: Only head loss uses cross-entropy on logits after subtracting each task block mean. B continues current-class CE on uncentered logits with detached classifier. Head uses detached features; old heads remain frozen. Fixed equal ten-class blocks; no learned offsets, temperature, mixing coefficient, margin or replay.
shared_start: Read the exact saved T2 model/state/RNG used by the qualified current-CE and raw-all-seen branches; do not reinitialize RRS or head. Reuse completed current control without optimizer updates; same GPU per seed, loader, transforms and numeric mode.
fixed_training: Original QV-r32 sharedRRS/fixedA/SSB B/FedAvg, head constrainedRegMean alpha.5, current-data only, old heads frozen, headAdamW .001 wd0 reset per client/round; B lr.0002; five rounds x five epochs batch16 per task. No rank/lr/alpha sweep.
numeric_mode: Same existing FP32/deterministic algorithms/mathSDPA/TF32 off/CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 for all new branches; no precision change.
qualification: CPU block-offset invariance and zero block-sum logit gradient; separated direct-B gradients exactly match current CE and old heads get no gradients. Real current vs centered preflight from shared start: exact input/label/B gradient and changed head gradient; actual first new training batch must match preflight before first optimizer update. Final lifecycle,10 new deployed certificates and raw/centered full-confusion reload per seed.

budget.clock: Same actual source started1792926949.7496953/deadline1793012449.7496953; preserve original clock and cost. Include new root plus prior head-loss/confirmation/pilot/round/basicrepair in conservative lineage allocation.

evaluation: Report all seeds and both raw and fixed-centered matrices/old/new/restricted/forgetting/error transfer. Include the reused current control and prior raw-all-seen arm. Same shared test set: development evidence, no independent heldout claim or checkpoint/rule selection.

gates.raw_safety_and_gain: Keep the previous raw primary gate: vs reused current raw, mean new gain>=5pp, mean old change>=-1pp and every old task in every seed>=-2pp. Prior raw-all-seen failure remains failed.
gates.aligned_centered_benefit: Additional gate vs reused current centered: mean overall gain>=0.5pp, mean new gain>=1pp, mean old change>=-1pp and every old task in every seed>=-2pp. Fixed centered rule is declared before this run; do not choose the best inference after seeing results.
gates.decision: Only consider full10 expansion if implementation qualification and BOTH gates pass; mixed/negative results remain mixed/negative, no threshold changes. Otherwise use evidence to choose a new targeted mainline hypothesis, not baseline tuning or a repeated control trajectory.

resource_admission: Same physical GPUs1/5/7; minimum12,000MiB free before launch, exceeding observed prior same-model startup2.7GiB by >4x. GPU need not be idle; do not stop or alter other jobs. New protocol admission threshold does not change old frozen jobs.
